title: Towards Data Contamination Detection for Modern Large Language Models: Limitations, Inconsistencies, and Oracle Challenges
paper_type_zh: 数据污染检测审计、受控构造 recipe 与负结果研究
best_for_zh: 设计基准污染审计、核查检测器假设、构造已知新增暴露对照，或评估开放审计 artifact 完整性的读者
one_line: Five prompt-, likelihood-, completion-, and order-based probes are compared on public benchmark slices; none consistently tracks known added fine-tuning exposure, and cross-method agreement is weak.
该研究把五种污染检测器作为不同的审计接口，在八个基准与一个受控 LLaMA-2 指令微调 oracle 上比较；五种指标都未能稳定追踪已知新增暴露比例，方法间一致性也很弱。
why: The study turns detector assumptions into auditable interfaces and supplies a rare known-exposure control, while showing that artifacts, distribution shifts, missing thresholds, and incompatible statistics can masquerade as evidence about memorization.
inclusion_reason: This negative-result anchor makes five contamination-detector data contracts inspectable, builds a known-added-exposure instruction-tuning oracle, and shows that their scores disagree and do not reliably track that exposure.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The final paper appears in the main proceedings of COLING 2025, pages 5058–5070. It asks whether five widely used or exploratory contamination detectors remain dependable on four modern language models and eight benchmarks, especially when exposure is introduced through instruction tuning rather than unchanged pretraining text. The evaluated models are GPT-4 (gpt-4-0613), Claude 3 Sonnet, LLaMA-3-70B-Chat, and LLaMA-2-70B-Chat; the benchmarks are GSM8K, MMLU, BIG-Bench-Hard, ARC-Challenge, DROP, HumanEval, AGNews, and IMDB.

The study does not define a single data object. Each audit case joins a model and benchmark split to one of five probe interfaces: a Word Perturbation Quiz (WPQ), a Local Order Quiz, guided versus general Token Completion Overlap, Min-K% token likelihood, or Canonical Order likelihood comparison. Their outputs are heterogeneous—quiz correctness, exact/near matches, ROUGE-L bootstrap p-values, low-token likelihood summaries, and order-preference p-values—and the paper reports mostly model-by-split aggregates rather than instance-level true/false contamination labels.

A second object is the controlled oracle construction. Selected benchmark fractions are intentionally added to LLaMA-2-70B-Chat through three epochs of instruction tuning at learning rate 8e-6. The questions are preserved, original answers are replaced with LLaMA-2-generated chain-of-thought answers, and four consecutive examples are packed into each training item. This establishes known newly added exposure, not a historically clean model: exposure already present in the base checkpoint remains unknown.

The public repository is a partial probe release. It contains fifteen JSON-formatted .txt files with 100 rows each (1,500 rows) and fifteen Token Overlap CSVs with ten rows each (150 rows). These are processed benchmark slices, not contamination annotations. It does not contain the oracle SFT corpus, checkpoint, complete original-order banks, generated choices or completions, detector outputs, or run logs.

This work belongs in Data Construction & Open Release Recipes because its main value for the track is the inspectable conversion from benchmark rows into method-specific audit records and a known-added-exposure SFT control. It is not a clean contamination benchmark, a universal detector, or a reasoning-training corpus. The sft tag records how the oracle is constructed; the released detector probes are intended for audit and evaluation, not as model-training rewards.

论文正式发表于 COLING 2025 主会论文集第 5058–5070 页。它考察五种常用或探索性的污染检测器，在四个现代语言模型与八个基准上是否仍然可靠，尤其关注训练暴露以指令微调而非原样预训练文本的方式加入时的表现。被测模型是 GPT-4（gpt-4-0613）、Claude 3 Sonnet、LLaMA-3-70B-Chat 和 LLaMA-2-70B-Chat；基准包括 GSM8K、MMLU、BIG-Bench-Hard、ARC-Challenge、DROP、HumanEval、AGNews 与 IMDB。

研究并未定义单一的数据对象。每个审计案例把一个模型、一个基准 split 与五种 probe 接口之一连接起来：Word Perturbation Quiz（WPQ）、Local Order Quiz、guided/general Token Completion Overlap、Min-K% token likelihood 或 Canonical Order likelihood comparison。它们输出的分别是 quiz 正误、exact/near match、ROUGE-L bootstrap p-value、低概率 token 的 likelihood 摘要以及顺序偏好 p-value；论文主要报告 model-by-split 聚合结果，而不是逐实例的污染真值标签。

第二类对象是受控 oracle 构造。研究以学习率 8e-6 对 LLaMA-2-70B-Chat 做三轮指令微调，有意加入选定比例的基准数据。问题保持原样，原始答案被 LLaMA-2 生成的 chain-of-thought 答案替换，每四个连续样例打包成一个训练项。该设计只建立了“已知新增暴露”，并不能说明模型在此之前历史上是干净的；base checkpoint 已有的暴露仍是 unknown。

公开仓库只构成部分 probe release。它包含 15 个 JSON 格式的 .txt 文件，每个 100 行，共 1,500 行；另有 15 个 Token Overlap CSV，每个 10 行，共 150 行。这些都是处理后的基准切片，不是污染标注。oracle SFT 语料、checkpoint、完整原始顺序数据池、生成的选项或 completion、检测器输出与运行日志均未公开。

该工作属于 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes，因为它对本 track 的核心价值是展示如何把 benchmark row 转换为方法特定的 audit record，并构造一个已知新增暴露的 SFT 对照。它不是干净的污染 benchmark、通用检测器或推理训练语料。sft 标签只描述 oracle 的构造方式；公开的 detector probe 用于 audit 与 evaluation，不是模型训练 reward。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper's central move is to treat “contamination detection” as five distinct measurement contracts rather than one interchangeable score. WPQ asks whether the model can identify an original item among four LLaMA-3-generated perturbations plus a None choice. Local Order asks which of four candidates immediately followed a target in the dataset. Both yield quiz accuracy, but accuracy above chance may reflect fluency or semantic adjacency rather than memorized training exposure.

Token Completion Overlap provides a partial instance under a general prompt and a dataset-guided prompt. The generated suffix is compared with the reference using ROUGE-L and GPT-4 exact/near-match judgments. The released implementation bootstraps guided and general score lists to obtain a one-sided empirical p-value. This contract mixes model generation, a learned judge, lexical overlap, and a statistical comparison; it does not directly emit an instance-level contamination label.

Min-K% uses probability access. For each text it averages negative log likelihood over the lowest-probability 20% of tokens and reports the mean and standard deviation over 100 examples. A larger value is expected to indicate greater familiarity in the method's interpretation, but no threshold is given for an arbitrary dataset. Canonical Order instead compares likelihoods of ten canonical shards with 25 shuffled variants per shard and maps ten paired differences to a one-sided t-based p-value.

The controlled oracle supplies the key test of these interfaces. LLaMA-2-70B-Chat is measured before and after instruction tuning on known fractions: MMLU test and BBH test at 100%; ARC-Challenge train and DROP train at 50% with their test splits at 0%; HumanEval test at 25%; and GSM8K train at 25% with its test split at 0%. The design asks whether a detector's output moves monotonically with known added exposure.

No common verifier, reward, or judge unifies the five methods. Programmatic quiz correctness, token likelihood, a GPT-4 match judge, lexical overlap, and order statistics observe different proxies. The paper's most important result is therefore a contract failure: none of these proxies consistently tracks the oracle fractions, and weak cross-method agreement prevents their outputs from being treated as mutually confirming contamination decisions.

论文的核心做法，是把“污染检测”拆成五种不同的测量 contract，而不是把它们视为可互换的同一种分数。WPQ 要求模型从四个由 LLaMA-3 生成的扰动版本与一个 None 选项中识别原始样例。Local Order 要求从四个候选项中选出数据集中紧接目标样例的记录。两者都输出 quiz accuracy，但高于随机水平的准确率可能来自语言流畅度或语义相邻性，而非记住了训练暴露。

Token Completion Overlap 在 general prompt 与 dataset-guided prompt 下提供部分样例，让模型补全后缀，再用 ROUGE-L 和 GPT-4 的 exact/near-match 判断与参考后缀比较。公开实现对 guided 与 general 的 score list 做 bootstrap，得到单侧经验 p-value。该 contract 混合了模型生成、学习型 judge、词面重合与统计比较，并不直接给出逐实例污染标签。

Min-K% 依赖概率访问。对每段文本，它取最低概率 20% token 的平均 negative log likelihood，并在 100 个样例上报告 mean 与 standard deviation。原方法把更高的数值解释为更强的熟悉度，但没有给出适用于任意数据集的判断阈值。Canonical Order 则把 10 个 canonical shard 的 likelihood 与每个 shard 的 25 个 shuffle 版本比较，再把 10 个配对差映射为单侧 t-based p-value。

受控 oracle 是检验这些接口的关键。LLaMA-2-70B-Chat 在微调前后分别测量，已知新增比例为：MMLU test 与 BBH test 各 100%；ARC-Challenge train 与 DROP train 各 50%，对应 test 各 0%；HumanEval test 为 25%；GSM8K train 为 25%，test 为 0%。设计所问的是 detector 输出能否随已知新增暴露单调变化。

五种方法之间没有统一的 verifier、reward 或 judge。程序化 quiz 正误、token likelihood、GPT-4 match judge、词面 overlap 和顺序统计量观察的是不同 proxy。论文最重要的结论因此是 contract 失效：没有一种 proxy 能稳定追踪 oracle 比例，方法间的弱一致性也不允许把它们当作相互印证的污染结论。

title: Method
方法
html:
The released probe inputs cover fifteen benchmark views: AGNews train/test; ARC-Challenge train/dev/test; BBH full; DROP train/dev/test; GSM8K train/test; HumanEval full; IMDB train/test; and MMLU test. Each .txt file has 100 JSON-formatted records, usually exposing idx, question, and optional label or category. Each companion Token Overlap CSV has ten records with text, first_piece, second_piece, and optional label. The paper and repository do not supply an upstream revision, row-level source ID, sampling script, or complete filter ledger.

For WPQ, LLaMA-3-70B-Chat produces four semantically similar perturbations, with up to five generation attempts. The original is inserted among four non-null choices and a fifth None option is added. Perturbation uses temperature 0.9 and top-p 0.9; evaluated-model inference uses temperature 0. HumanEval perturbs docstrings, DROP perturbs passage and question, and answer choices are removed before perturbing several multiple-choice/classification datasets. Accuracy is aggregated over 100 records.

Local Order samples a target and presents four candidate records, nominally including exactly one immediate successor. Options are restricted to the same category for MMLU and BBH, and the prompt includes a dataset description, name, split, and records. It uses 100 targets and a nominal 25% chance baseline. Reproduction additionally needs the complete original-order dataset bank, but the referenced full_datasets directory is not released.

Token Completion Overlap splits ten records into a prefix and reference suffix, obtains a general completion and a dataset-guided completion, and compares them with the suffix. GPT-4 at temperature 0 labels exact and near matches; one exact or two near matches are stated as detection thresholds. ROUGE-L scores are rounded to two decimals, then the released code independently resamples the two ten-score lists 10,000 times without a fixed bootstrap seed and reports a one-sided empirical p-value.

Min-K% uses k=20 and 100 examples per split, retaining the lowest-probability fifth of tokens and reporting descriptive split-level mean and standard deviation. Canonical Order concatenates question-answer records with newlines, divides 100 examples into ten shards, evaluates one canonical plus 25 shuffled orders per shard, and performs a one-sided comparison over ten differences. The released statistic uses NumPy's population standard deviation (ddof=0) but a Student-t CDF with n-1 degrees of freedom.

For the oracle, questions from the chosen benchmark fractions retain their original wording, while LLaMA-2-generated chain-of-thought replaces the answers. Four consecutive examples are packed per SFT item to preserve some local order. LLaMA-2-70B-Chat is fine-tuned for three epochs at learning rate 8e-6. Optimizer, batch size, precision, sequence length, hardware, seeds, training command, corpus, checkpoint, and hashes are undisclosed, and no matched nonbenchmark SFT control is reported.

公开 probe input 覆盖 15 个 benchmark view：AGNews train/test；ARC-Challenge train/dev/test；BBH full；DROP train/dev/test；GSM8K train/test；HumanEval full；IMDB train/test；MMLU test。每个 .txt 文件含 100 个 JSON 格式记录，通常暴露 idx、question，以及可选的 label 或 category。每个配套 Token Overlap CSV 含 10 条记录，字段为 text、first_piece、second_piece，以及可选的 label。论文与仓库都未提供每个 view 的 upstream revision、逐行 source ID、采样脚本或完整过滤 ledger。

WPQ 由 LLaMA-3-70B-Chat 生成四个语义近似的扰动版本，最多尝试五次。原始样例被插入四个非空选项之一，再增加第五个 None 选项。扰动生成使用 temperature 0.9、top-p 0.9；被测模型推理 temperature 为 0。HumanEval 只扰动 docstring，DROP 扰动 passage 与 question，若干选择题/分类数据集在扰动前去除 answer choice。最终在 100 条记录上聚合准确率。

Local Order 采样一个 target，并提供四个候选记录，名义上恰有一个是原始数据中的直接后继。MMLU 与 BBH 的候选限制在同 category，prompt 包含 dataset description、name、split 与记录本身。它使用 100 个 target，名义随机基线为 25%。复现还需要完整的原始顺序数据池，但代码所引用的 full_datasets 目录未发布。

Token Completion Overlap 把 10 条记录分成 prefix 与参考 suffix，分别取得 general completion 与 dataset-guided completion，再与 suffix 比较。GPT-4 在 temperature 0 下判断 exact/near match；论文把一个 exact 或两个 near match 作为检测阈值。ROUGE-L score 先四舍五入到两位小数，随后公开代码对两组各 10 个 score 独立重采样 10,000 次，在没有固定 bootstrap seed 的情况下报告单侧经验 p-value。

Min-K% 使用 k=20，每个 split 取 100 个样例，保留最低概率的五分之一 token，并报告描述性的 split-level mean 与 standard deviation。Canonical Order 用换行连接 question-answer，100 条记录分成 10 个 shard；每个 shard 计算一个 canonical 顺序和 25 个 shuffle 顺序，再对 10 个差值做单侧比较。公开统计量使用 NumPy population standard deviation（ddof=0），却使用自由度 n-1 的 Student-t CDF。

oracle 构造保留所选 benchmark fraction 的原始问题，以 LLaMA-2 生成的 chain-of-thought 替换答案，并把四个连续样例打包为一个 SFT item，以保留部分局部顺序。LLaMA-2-70B-Chat 以学习率 8e-6 微调三轮。optimizer、batch size、precision、sequence length、hardware、seed、training command、corpus、checkpoint 与 hash 均未披露，也没有 token 数匹配的非 benchmark SFT 对照。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is the before/after oracle comparison, because its newly added benchmark fractions are known. None of the five detector metrics moves consistently with those fractions. Even the 100%-added MMLU and BBH test exposures are not reliably detected, demonstrating a false-negative pathway for instruction-tuning exposure with answer augmentation. Conversely, a 0%-added test split can move after tuning on the same benchmark's train split, demonstrating a distribution-mediated false-positive pathway for test-set contamination.

Min-K% is especially diagnostic of the reliability problem: its values decrease for all tested splits after known added contamination, opposite the expected direction. This does not establish that the underlying benchmark data are clean or that Min-K% always fails; it shows that the tested statistic and interpretation do not robustly transfer to this controlled SFT setting.

Agreement across the five methods is also weak. Off-diagonal Spearman correlations range from -0.198 to 0.320. The paper acknowledges taking “slight statistical liberty” when aligning p-values and other metric directions for the comparison. Thus, the correlations are evidence that these implementations do not corroborate one another under the chosen aggregation—not a calibrated estimate of any detector's sensitivity or specificity.

The four-model/eight-benchmark tables provide descriptive outputs for modern production and open-weight models, but those models' true historical training exposure is unknown. A high WPQ or Local Order accuracy, low Token Overlap p-value, Min-K summary, or Canonical Order p-value cannot independently prove contamination. The paper's claims about likely contamination on particular real-model splits remain method-dependent hypotheses, not ground-truth labels.

No result in the paper demonstrates data quality for model training. Benchmark performance may rise because of memorization, generalization, or other training changes; detector performance may change because of prompt artifacts, likelihood calibration, distribution shift, ordering, or judge variance. The evidence supports a negative audit conclusion—current probes are inconsistent and fragile—not a positive claim that the released 1,650 probe rows constitute verified high-quality training data.

最强的证据来自 oracle 的 before/after 比较，因为新增 benchmark 暴露比例是已知的。五种 detector metric 都未能随这些比例稳定变化。即使 MMLU 与 BBH test 被 100% 加入，方法也不能可靠检出，说明带 answer augmentation 的指令微调暴露存在 false-negative 路径。反过来，在同一 benchmark 的 train split 上微调后，新增比例为 0% 的 test split 也可能发生指标变化，形成由同分布迁移造成的 test-set contamination false positive。

Min-K% 尤其能说明可靠性问题：已知新增污染后，所有受测 split 的值都下降，与预期方向相反。这并不证明原 benchmark 数据是干净的，也不能证明 Min-K% 在所有场景中总会失败；它只说明该统计量及其解释没有稳健迁移到此受控 SFT 设置。

五种方法之间的一致性同样很弱。非对角 Spearman correlation 范围为 -0.198 到 0.320。论文承认，在对齐 p-value 与其他 metric direction 时采用了 “slight statistical liberty”。因此，这些相关性只能说明所选聚合下各实现没有相互印证，不能当作任一 detector sensitivity 或 specificity 的校准估计。

四模型、八 benchmark 的表格给出了现代闭源与开源权重模型的描述性输出，但这些模型真实的历史训练暴露未知。较高的 WPQ 或 Local Order accuracy、较低的 Token Overlap p-value、Min-K summary 或 Canonical Order p-value 都不能独立证明污染。论文对某些真实模型 split 的“可能污染”判断仍是方法依赖的假设，不是 ground-truth label。

论文没有任何结果证明这些数据适合模型训练。benchmark performance 上升可能来自 memorization、generalization 或其他训练变化；detector performance 变化也可能来自 prompt artifact、likelihood calibration、distribution shift、顺序或 judge variance。证据支持的是一个负面审计结论——现有 probe 不一致且脆弱——而不是把公开的 1,650 条 probe 记录称作经验证的高质量训练数据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The individual detector families are not all new: Min-K%, Canonical Order, Token Completion Overlap, and Word Perturbation Quiz adapt prior work. The paper's own exploratory contribution is Local Order, which tests memory for dataset adjacency. Its broader novelty is experimental: five heterogeneous probe contracts are implemented side by side across four modern models and eight benchmarks instead of being evaluated in isolated settings.

The controlled instruction-tuning oracle is the more important contribution for data construction. By retaining benchmark questions, replacing answers with generated chain-of-thought, varying known added fractions, and packing consecutive examples, it tests a contamination form that differs from unchanged pretraining text. The before/after design makes detector directionality inspectable even though it cannot certify that the base checkpoint was clean.

For this track, the work is valuable as an audit-failure recipe. It exposes how a benchmark row becomes a perturbation quiz, completion pair, likelihood record, or ordered shard, and it shows which generated or intermediate artifacts would be needed to audit that transformation. The negative result—that ostensibly accepted methods neither track known exposure nor agree with each other—is more informative than a leaderboard-style detector claim.

The novelty boundary must remain narrow. This is not a universal contamination detector, not an instance-level membership ground truth, not a clean benchmark release, and not a complete oracle-training package. Local Order itself has an implementation defect that can duplicate the true successor, and the oracle controls only newly added exposure. The contribution is a comparative stress test and a partially released construction recipe.

各 detector family 并非全部由本文首次提出：Min-K%、Canonical Order、Token Completion Overlap 与 Word Perturbation Quiz 都改编自先前工作。论文自身提出的探索性方法是 Local Order，用来检测模型对 dataset adjacency 的记忆。更广义的创新在实验设计：五种异构 probe contract 被放在同一框架下，跨四个现代模型和八个 benchmark 比较，而不是各自在隔离设置中验证。

对数据构造而言，受控 instruction-tuning oracle 是更重要的贡献。它保留 benchmark question，以生成的 chain-of-thought 替换 answer，改变已知新增比例并打包连续样例，从而测试一种不同于原样 pretraining text 的污染形式。before/after 设计让 detector directionality 可被检查，尽管它无法证明 base checkpoint 是干净的。

对本 track 而言，该工作可作为 audit-failure recipe：它展示 benchmark row 如何变成 perturbation quiz、completion pair、likelihood record 或 ordered shard，也揭示审计转换过程必须保留哪些生成物与中间 artifact。与其给出 leaderboard 式 detector 宣称，更有价值的负结果是：这些被广泛接受的方法既不能追踪已知暴露，也不能彼此一致。

创新边界必须保持收敛。这不是通用污染检测器、逐实例 membership ground truth、干净 benchmark release，也不是完整的 oracle-training package。Local Order 本身存在可能重复 true successor 的实现缺陷，oracle 也只控制 newly added exposure。它的贡献是 comparative stress test 与部分公开的 construction recipe。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The five contracts have different confounds. WPQ can reward recognition of natural wording, unchanged labels, proper nouns, numbers, or formatting artifacts rather than memorization. Token Completion Overlap uses only ten records, prompt-sensitive suffixes, GPT-4 match judgment, and an independently resampled 10,000-draw bootstrap after rounding scores to two decimals; it has no fixed bootstrap seed. Min-K% has no operational threshold for an unlabeled corpus and reverses its expected direction in the oracle.

Both order methods assume that original dataset order survived training. Shuffling during pretraining can erase the signal, while semantic or categorical adjacency can reveal the successor without memorization. More seriously, the released Local Order negative sampler does not exclude the true successor before inserting it, so a quiz can contain the correct successor twice and violate its exactly-one-correct-option prompt contract. Canonical Order computes its t statistic using population standard deviation (ddof=0) but evaluates it with a Student-t distribution at n-1 degrees of freedom; this nonstandard choice matters with ten shards.

The oracle establishes known newly added exposure, not total contamination. The LLaMA-2 base model may already have seen benchmark material, and no token-budget-matched nonbenchmark SFT control isolates general calibration or distribution changes caused by fine-tuning. Generated chain-of-thought also changes the answer form, so the experiment probes one realistic but specific exposure mechanism. No independent training repetitions, confidence intervals for quiz accuracies, sampling robustness, or multiple-comparison correction are reported.

The repository is not turnkey. main.py searches for .json order files while the released records end in .txt; Local Order needs an absent full_datasets directory; Canonical Order references absent canonical directories and an unset example fine-tuned model. Min-K and Canonical scripts depend on Together likelihood behavior and credentials that the user must supply. The oracle generation/training code, checkpoint, outputs, likelihood vectors, permutations, perturbations, completions, parser failures, and run logs are missing. Pinned Python requirements do not specify a full platform/CUDA/container environment.

Reuse rights are unresolved. The COLING paper is CC BY 4.0, but the GitHub repository has no LICENSE, dataset card, or per-source rights ledger. The fifteen processed benchmark families have no attached upstream revisions or row-level provenance. The inspected commit is a post-publication repository state with no formal release tag, so it cannot be assumed to be the exact paper snapshot.

One textual inconsistency also remains: a results sentence names Claude 3 Haiku, while the method description, Table 1, its caption, Table 3, and the released runner name Claude 3 Sonnet. This Card uses Sonnet because it has the stronger repeated support, but the exact checkpoint used in every pipeline remains unknown.

五种 contract 各有不同 confound。WPQ 可能奖励模型识别自然措辞、未改动 label、proper noun、number 或 formatting artifact，而非 memorization。Token Completion Overlap 只有 10 条记录，依赖 prompt-sensitive suffix 与 GPT-4 match judgment，并在 score 四舍五入到两位小数后做独立重采样的 10,000 次 bootstrap，且没有固定 bootstrap seed。Min-K% 没有适用于无标签语料的 operational threshold，在 oracle 中还出现预期方向反转。

两种 order 方法都假设原始 dataset order 在训练中得到保留。pretraining shuffle 可能抹去信号，语义或类别相邻性也可能在没有 memorization 时提示正确后继。更严重的是，公开 Local Order 的 negative sampler 在插入 true successor 前没有把它从负样本中排除，因此 quiz 可能出现两次正确后继，违反 prompt 所声明的 exactly-one-correct-option contract。Canonical Order 使用 population standard deviation（ddof=0）计算 t statistic，却以 n-1 自由度的 Student-t distribution 求值；在仅 10 个 shard 时，这个非标准选择有实质影响。

oracle 确立的是已知新增暴露，不是总污染。LLaMA-2 base model 可能已经见过 benchmark material，而且没有 token-budget-matched nonbenchmark SFT control 来隔离微调引发的一般 calibration 或 distribution change。生成的 chain-of-thought 也改变了答案形式，因此实验只覆盖一种现实但特定的暴露机制。论文没有报告独立训练重复、quiz accuracy 的 confidence interval、对采样选择的 robustness 或 multiple-comparison correction。

仓库不能 turnkey 运行。main.py 搜索 .json 顺序文件，而公开记录以 .txt 结尾；Local Order 依赖缺失的 full_datasets 目录；Canonical Order 引用不存在的 canonical 目录和未设置的示例 finetuned model。Min-K 与 Canonical script 依赖 Together likelihood 行为，并要求用户自行提供 credential。oracle 生成/训练代码、checkpoint、输出、likelihood vector、permutation、perturbation、completion、parser failure 与 run log 都未发布。虽然 Python dependency 有 pin，但没有完整 platform/CUDA/container 环境。

复用权利尚未解决。COLING 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但 GitHub 仓库没有 LICENSE、dataset card 或逐来源 rights ledger。15 个处理后 benchmark view 没有附 upstream revision 或逐行 provenance。被检查的 commit 是论文发表后的仓库状态，且没有正式 release tag，因此不能假定它就是论文实验 snapshot。

文本中还有一处模型名称矛盾：一个结果段落写 Claude 3 Haiku，而方法说明、Table 1、其 caption、Table 3 与公开 runner 都写 Claude 3 Sonnet。本 Card 因重复证据更强而采用 Sonnet，但各 pipeline 的精确 checkpoint 仍是 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Data Construction & Open Release Recipes, the paper is most useful as a template for specifying an audit record before interpreting its score. A practitioner can map each detector to its required input, generated intermediate, judge or statistic, aggregation level, and failure modes. That exercise prevents quiz accuracy, likelihood, overlap, and p-values from being collapsed into a fictitious common label.

The known-added-exposure oracle is a useful design reference for detector evaluation. Its fraction matrix and before/after measurements make false negatives and same-distribution false positives observable. A stronger reuse should add a demonstrably clean or better-characterized base, a token-matched nonbenchmark SFT control, repeated training seeds, exact corpus manifests, and calibrated confusion matrices.

The released 1,500 processed records and 150 completion slices can help reconstruct or unit-test parts of the five probe interfaces. They are insufficient for paper-level reproduction because original-order banks, generated artifacts, oracle data and checkpoint, output logs, and several execution paths are absent. Any reconstruction should pin upstream dataset revisions and repository SHA, fix the Local Order duplicate-option bug, revisit the Canonical Order statistic, and retain all successes, failures, options, draws, and likelihood vectors.

The work can also serve as a release-audit checklist: publish row-level provenance and rights, exact sampling/filtering code, complete generated artifacts, immutable run manifests, model/API versions, seeds, statistical procedures, and a failure ledger. Repository code and processed data should not be redistributed or trained on until their missing license and upstream terms are resolved.

The sft training-use label is deliberately narrow. Supervised fine-tuning is used to construct the controlled oracle; the detector scores are not rewards, preferences, correctness labels, or recommended supervision. Appropriate uses are audit, evaluation, detector stress testing, and recipe comparison—not treating the public probe rows as certified reasoning-training data.

对于 Data Construction & Open Release Recipes，该论文最适合作为一种规范：在解释 score 之前，先明确 audit record 的 contract。实践者可以为每个 detector 列出所需 input、生成的 intermediate、judge 或 statistic、aggregation level 与 failure mode，避免把 quiz accuracy、likelihood、overlap 和 p-value 错误折叠成虚构的统一标签。

known-added-exposure oracle 是设计 detector evaluation 的有用参考。其 fraction matrix 与 before/after 测量让 false negative 和同分布 false positive 可被观察。更强的复用版本应增加经证明干净或至少背景更清楚的 base、token-matched nonbenchmark SFT control、重复 training seed、精确 corpus manifest 与 calibrated confusion matrix。

公开的 1,500 条处理记录与 150 条 completion slice 可以帮助重建或 unit-test 五种 probe interface 的一部分，但不足以复现论文：original-order bank、生成 artifact、oracle data/checkpoint、output log 与若干执行路径都缺失。任何重建都应 pin upstream dataset revision 与 repository SHA，修复 Local Order duplicate-option bug，重新检查 Canonical Order statistic，并保留全部成功/失败样例、选项、抽样结果和 likelihood vector。

该工作还可作为 release-audit checklist：公开逐行 provenance 与 rights、精确 sampling/filtering code、完整 generated artifact、immutable run manifest、model/API version、seed、statistical procedure 与 failure ledger。在缺失的仓库许可和 upstream terms 得到解决前，不应重新分发或用仓库代码/处理数据直接训练。

sft training-use 标签的含义被刻意限制：监督微调只用于构造受控 oracle；detector score 不是 reward、preference、correctness label 或推荐 supervision。合适用途是 audit、evaluation、detector stress testing 与 recipe comparison，而不是把公开 probe row 当作经过认证的 reasoning-training data。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 4 and Figure 1 first to separate the five data contracts; their outputs are not interchangeable contamination labels.
  • Treat the Section 5 oracle as a known-added-exposure control. It does not establish a clean LLaMA-2 base checkpoint or total historical exposure.
  • Cross-check the before/after oracle tables for direction, not merely significance: all reported Min-K% values move opposite the expected contamination direction.
  • Inspect the repository before reproducing Local Order or Canonical Order. The former can duplicate the true successor; the latter uses a population-SD t statistic, and both require missing order assets.
  • Keep the release boundary explicit: 1,500 processed .txt rows and 150 completion CSV rows are public, but oracle records, generated probes, outputs, checkpoints, and logs are not.
  • Do not infer safe reuse from public access. The paper is CC BY 4.0, while repository code/data terms and per-source benchmark rights are unknown.

• 先读 Section 4 与 Figure 1，把五种 data contract 分开；它们的输出不是可互换的污染标签。
  • 把 Section 5 的 oracle 理解为“已知新增暴露”对照。它不能证明 LLaMA-2 base checkpoint 干净，也不能确定总历史暴露。
  • 对照 before/after oracle table 时要看方向，不只看显著性：所有报告的 Min-K% 值都朝预期污染方向的反方向变化。
  • 复现 Local Order 或 Canonical Order 前先检查仓库。前者可能重复 true successor，后者使用 population-SD t statistic，而且两者都依赖缺失的顺序 artifact。
  • 明确 release boundary：公开的是 1,500 条处理后 .txt row 和 150 条 completion CSV row；oracle record、generated probe、output、checkpoint 与 log 均未公开。
  • 不要由“可公开访问”推断“可安全复用”。论文是 CC BY 4.0，但仓库代码/数据条款与逐来源 benchmark 权利均为 unknown。

items: WPQ may recognize unnatural perturbations, labels, proper nouns, numbers, or formatting rather than memorization.
Token Overlap uses ten items, GPT-4 judgment, prompt-sensitive suffixes, and an unseeded rounded-score bootstrap.
Min-K lacks a usable threshold and decreases after known added exposure, opposite the expected direction.
Order tests assume ordering survived training; semantic adjacency can cue a model without memorization.
Local Order code may sample the true successor as a negative and insert it again, yielding duplicate correct choices.
Canonical Order uses NumPy population standard deviation with a Student-t distribution at n=10, not the conventional sample-SD statistic.
The oracle proves added exposure only, lacks a matched nonbenchmark SFT control, and cannot isolate base-model contamination.
None of the five metrics consistently tracks the known added fractions; both false negatives and same-distribution false positives occur.
Off-diagonal Spearman correlations range from -0.198 to 0.320; heterogeneous metric directions are compared.
The paper has a Sonnet/Haiku inconsistency; stronger repeated evidence supports Sonnet.
The repository references absent full_datasets and canonical directories, mismatched .json/.txt paths, and an unset example model name.
No repeated runs, quiz-accuracy confidence intervals, sample-choice robustness, or multiplicity correction are reported.
WPQ 可能识别不自然的扰动、标签、专有名词、数字或格式，而非记忆。
Token Overlap 使用十个条目、GPT-4 判断、提示敏感后缀，以及无 seed 的四舍五入分数 bootstrap。
Min-K 缺乏可用阈值，且在已知新增暴露后下降，与预期方向相反。
顺序测试假设顺序在训练后仍保留；语义邻接可在无记忆的情况下为模型提供线索。
Local Order 代码可能将真正后继采样为负例并再次插入，产生重复的正确选项。
Canonical Order 使用 NumPy 总体标准差与 n=10 的 Student-t 分布，而非常规的样本标准差统计量。
oracle 仅证明新增暴露，缺乏匹配的非基准 SFT 对照，且不能分离基座模型污染。
五个指标无一一致跟踪已知新增比例；假阴性与同分布假阳性均会发生。
非对角 Spearman 相关范围为 -0.198 至 0.320；比较了异构的指标方向。
论文存在 Sonnet/Haiku 不一致；更强的重复证据支持 Sonnet。
仓库引用了缺失的 full_datasets 与 canonical 目录、不匹配的 .json/.txt 路径，以及未设置的示例模型名。
未报告重复运行、测验准确率置信区间、样本选择鲁棒性或多重比较校正。
